components.name: Primary Button
components.description: High-visibility Ember Signal CTA with Espresso Canvas ink for 6.28:1 WCAG AA contrast.
components.css: .ds-btn-primary { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; gap: 8px; background: var(--color-accent-orange, #f46c38); color: #151312; font-size: 14px; font-weight: 700; padding: 12px 24px; border: none; border-radius: 12px; cursor: pointer; box-shadow: 0 4px 6px -1px rgba(244, 108, 56, 0.2); transition: filter 0.15s cubic-bezier(0.4, 0, 0.2, 1), transform 0.15s cubic-bezier(0.4, 0, 0.2, 1); } .ds-btn-primary:hover { filter: brightness(1.05); } .ds-btn-primary:active { transform: scale(0.98); } .ds-btn-primary:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #f46c38; outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Secondary Button
components.description: Espresso Canvas secondary action button for viewing or downloading the resume PDF.
components.css: .ds-btn-secondary { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; gap: 8px; background: var(--color-canvas, #151312); color: #ffffff; font-size: 12px; font-weight: 600; padding: 10px 16px; border: none; border-radius: 12px; cursor: pointer; box-shadow: 0 1px 3px 0 rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.1); transition: background-color 0.15s cubic-bezier(0.4, 0, 0.2, 1), transform 0.15s cubic-bezier(0.4, 0, 0.2, 1); } .ds-btn-secondary:hover { background: #252220; } .ds-btn-secondary:active { transform: scale(0.98); } .ds-btn-secondary:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--color-accent-orange, #f46c38); outline-offset: 2px; }

components.css: .ds-btn-social { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; gap: 8px; background: #f4f1ed; color: #151312; font-size: 12px; font-weight: 600; padding: 10px 12px; border-radius: 12px; text-decoration: none; transition: background-color 0.15s cubic-bezier(0.4, 0, 0.2, 1); } .ds-btn-social:hover { background: #e8e4dc; } .ds-btn-social:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--color-accent-orange, #f46c38); outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Core Tech Chip

components.css: .ds-chip-tech { display: inline-block; padding: 4px 10px; border-radius: 8px; background: #f4f1ed; color: #151312; font-size: 12px; font-weight: 600; line-height: 1.33; }

narrative.overview:
The High-Contrast Workbench pairs a deep espresso-dark editorial canvas (#151312) with a luminous white credential anchor card (#ffffff) and high-voltage Ember Signal (#f46c38) and Volt Lime (#c5ff41) accents. Built for rapid engineering-manager evaluation, the system balances bold, kinetic oversized typography against crisp, scannable proof blocks—letting visitors read the engineer's credentials at a glance on the left while scrolling through projects, experience milestones, stack capabilities, and direct contact on the right.

The aesthetic is intentionally bold, kinetic, and recruiter-scannable rather than clinical or monochromatic. It rejects generic sterile white SaaS templates and low-contrast monochrome grids in favor of tactile rounded surfaces, stacked two-tone display headlines, and decisive signal colors that mark active stages, completed milestones, and primary conversion paths.
keyCharacteristics: High-contrast polarity between the sticky Paper Anchor (#ffffff) profile island and the Espresso Canvas (#151312) narrative stage
Oversized dual-tone uppercase display headings pairing solid white (#ffffff) with translucent Ghost Mist (rgba(182, 180, 189, 0.55))
Tactile, squircle-rounded containers (16px–24px radii) with hairline borders and selective ambient accent glows

Dual signal hierarchy: Ember Signal (#f46c38 paired with #151312 ink on solid fills, #b84316 on white surfaces) for primary action and active state; Volt Lime (#c5ff41 paired with #000000 ink) for completion and status indicators

rules.name: The Polarity Anchor Rule
rules.body: Only the sticky profile summary card uses Paper Anchor (#ffffff) as a card canvas; all scrolling narrative sections live on Espresso Canvas (#151312) and Surface Veil (rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.03)) so the engineer's identity remains permanently anchored in view.

rules.name: The Signal Separation Rule
rules.body: Ember Signal (#f46c38) owns attention, hover intent, and active progress; Volt Lime (#c5ff41) owns completed states and success feedback. Never pair solid Ember Signal or Volt Lime fills with white text—always use dark #151312 / #000000 ink on solid accent fills, and use Ember Ink (#b84316) for orange text on #ffffff.

rules.name: The Dual-Tone Stack Rule
rules.body: Every major section opens with a two-line uppercase 800-weight Display heading at 0.95 line-height: the top phrase in full Paper Anchor (#ffffff) and the bottom anchor word in Ghost Mist (rgba(182, 180, 189, 0.55)), keeping a single <h1> in About and <h2> on subsequent sections.

rules.name: The Flat-At-Rest Surface Rule
rules.body: Dark content cards (Project, TechStack, completed Experience cards) carry zero drop shadow at rest; depth comes from subtle rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.05) borders, and interactive hover shifts appear only on linked cards (href present).

dos: Do preserve the single Paper Anchor (#ffffff) sticky profile card against the Espresso Canvas (#151312) stage so identity and primary CTAs stay immediately scannable (The Polarity Anchor Rule).

Do pair solid Ember Signal (#f46c38) and Volt Lime (#c5ff41) surfaces strictly with dark (#151312 / #000000) ink, and use Ember Ink (#b84316) for orange text on white surfaces (The Signal Separation Rule).
Do maintain the nested corner-radius hierarchy (24px outer cards → 16px inner fields/frames → 12px buttons/icon boxes → 8px chips).
Do open major content sections with the two-line 800-weight uppercase Display header (0.95 line-height) splitting solid white and Ghost Mist (rgba(182, 180, 189, 0.55)).
donts: Don't turn dark content sections into sterile white SaaS cards or add cursor-pointer / arrow cues to non-interactive cards (The Flat-At-Rest Surface Rule).
Don't add unlayered CSS element padding/radius rules in src/App.css that override Tailwind v4 utilities, or strip :focus-visible outlines without replacement.
Don't place white text on Ember Signal (#f46c38) or Volt Lime (#c5ff41) solid backgrounds.
Don't load unrequested decorative font families or complex multi-hue gradients that dilute the two-accent Ember Signal + Volt Lime system.
